name: The Brassbolts Brothers
summary: Pilot Longbeard in Ironforge needs a traveler to carry helmets to the Brassbolts Brothers. Their test drivers keep crashing rocket cars at the Shimmering Flats, so the gnomes need head protection.

sections.title: A Long-Distance Favor
sections.body: Pilot Longbeard, a dwarven aviator in Ironforge, has an urgent request from the Shimmering Flats in southern Kalimdor. His friends, the inventive gnome Brassbolts brothers, have settled on its vast salt pans to race experimental machines. Longbeard's military and piloting duties keep him busy, so he cannot carry their supplies himself.

sections.title: Safety at High Velocity
sections.body: The Brassbolts' rocket car races across the salt beds at extraordinary speed. Yet its test drivers keep crashing and suffering severe concussions. Longbeard has gathered a crate of heavy-duty dwarven Siege Engine helmets to protect them. You carry the crate across the sea to Kalimdor, giving the gnomes the protection they need to bring reluctant pilots back behind the wheel.

faq.answer: Pilot Longbeard is a dwarven siege engine pilot in Ironforge. He is a friend and supply contact for the Brassbolts brothers in the Eastern Kingdoms, where he can obtain heavy dwarven gear they cannot easily make in the field.
The Brassbolts brothers are ambitious gnomish engineers, including Wizzle Brassbolts. At the Mirage Raceway in the Shimmering Flats, they design and tune rocket cars to outrun goblin competitors.

The Shimmering Flats is a vast, sun-baked salt plain in southern Kalimdor, beyond the tall canyon pillars of Thousand Needles. Its broad, obstacle-free stretch suits the testing of fast experimental vehicles.

faq.q: Why do the gnomes need Siege Engine helmets?
faq.answer: The Brassbolts need Siege Engine helmets because their rocket car is extremely fast, while its steering and stability are poor. Crashes and concussions became so common that no test pilots would drive without substantial dwarven head protection.

faq.q: Why doesn't Longbeard deliver them himself?
faq.answer: Pilot Longbeard is occupied with military duties in Ironforge. The long voyage across the Great Sea to southern Kalimdor would mean abandoning his post, so he relies on travelers to carry the heavy crate.

faq.q: Can Horde players complete this task?
faq.answer: No. Pilot Longbeard offers this work in Ironforge, the Alliance capital, so only Alliance couriers can take it. The Mirage Raceway itself welcomes both factions.

angles.text: As a gnome, you can see the Brassbolts prize mechanical innovation above details like braking and their drivers' longevity.
As a dwarf, you know sturdy dwarven Siege Engine armor is thick enough to withstand a full-throttle collision on the salt flats.
As an engineer, you can appreciate how this supply run joins dwarven heavy-armor craftsmanship with gnomish high-velocity experiments.
